text: On Christmas Eve, four months after [the car crash that killed her husband|wrong|an accident and its guilt], the photographer Sarah Scarangella waits alone in her house to give birth the next day. A woman she does not know knocks, asks to use the telephone, and knows her husband is dead. That night the stranger appears at her bedside [with a pair of scissors|images|weapons and tools], [wanting the unborn child for herself|wants|a child to take or have], and Sarah locks herself in the bathroom as her mother, her employer and the police arrive one by one [to try to help|who_suffers|those who step in].
